code:
from manim import *
from manim_chemistry import BohrAtom

class BohrAtomSilicon(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        atom = BohrAtom(e=14, p=14, n=10)
        label = Text("Silicon (Si)", font_size=28).next_to(atom, DOWN)
        self.add(atom, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
